name: City of STEM LA 2026

venue.name: Exposition Park
venue.address: 700 Exposition Park Dr, Los Angeles, CA 90037

information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CityofSTEMLA2026#70408-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/), [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/) and [City of STEM](https://www.cityofstem.org/).
